name: legacy-frozen-comparison-splits
purpose: Final like-for-like comparison on the original 118,990-row training split
known_limitations: The legacy splits predate normalized-text deduplication and contain a small number of normalized cross-split overlaps.

These fingerprints are retained specifically to make the new 118,990-row DistilBERT runs comparable with the historical BiLSTM and classical runs. Dataset v2 is a separate future benchmark generation.
